en:
A soft melody fills the quiet lobby, and a Pokémon flickers into sight!
It stops singing and turns to {player}!
text:
O melodie blândă umple holul tăcut și un Pokémon apare pâlpâind!
Se oprește din cântat și se întoarce spre {player}!

en: The lobby is silent. The last note seems to hang in the air...
text: Holul e tăcut. Ultima notă pare să plutească încă în aer...

en: Meloetta's song faded away behind the stage's door...
text: Cântecul lui Meloetta s-a stins dincolo de ușa scenei...

en: Ah, a new face! I am the owner of this theater, and every Pokémon deserves a turn in the spotlight.
Take this trunk. It holds a few Props to start with: hats, glasses, a cape and more.
{player} received the Prop Trunk and {number} Props!
Dress a Pokémon of yours at the desk, then take the stage against our three performers. The crowd decides the rest!
A musical is music, dance and costume all at once. Pokémon shine in all three!
Win the crowd's eyes with tricks on the beat, and wear Props that suit the show's mood.
Welcome, darling. What will it be today?
DRESSING ROOM
TAKE THE STAGE
NOTHING
Do come back when you feel like shining.
Divine! Your Pokémon will remember that look on stage.
Splendid! Choose a show and a performer. Press on the beat when the spotlight finds you!
What a performance! The crowd will be talking about it all evening.
First place! The whole theater was looking at your Pokémon!
Another time, then. The stage will wait for you.
The dressing room is through there. Only performers and their Pokémon may go in, darling.
Speak to the owner first. He has something for every new performer.
I saw your show! It was wonderful. Please, take this for your next one!
{player} received a Prop: {thing}!
You were amazing up there! I made this for your Pokémon. Please wear it on stage!
{player} received a Prop: {thing}!
That was a real performance! My Pokémon and I want you to have this.
{player} received a Prop: {thing}!
